description: Tests, documentation, and deployment configuration - Create comprehensive test suite, seed data for development, Docker configuration, and CI/CD pipeline configuration.
steps: Create jest.config.ts with Next.js preset, path aliases, coverage thresholds
Create src/__tests__/lib/matching.test.ts - Unit tests for matching engine (score calculation, weight factors, edge cases like no preferences, perfect match, partial match)
Create src/__tests__/lib/validators.test.ts - Unit tests for Zod validation schemas (valid inputs, invalid inputs, edge cases)
Create src/__tests__/api/bookings.test.ts - Integration tests for booking API (create, cancel, complete flow)
Create src/__tests__/api/matching.test.ts - Integration tests for matching endpoint
Create src/__tests__/components/MatchCard.test.tsx - Component test for match card rendering
Create prisma/seed.ts - Database seed script with sample instructors (varied specialisms, locations, styles), sample students (varied preferences), sample bookings and reviews
Create Dockerfile - Multi-stage build (deps, build, production) with Node 22 Alpine, prisma generate, next build
Create docker-compose.yml - Services for app, postgres, with volumes and environment
Create .github/workflows/ci.yml - CI pipeline with lint, type-check, test, build steps
Create .env.example with comprehensive documentation of each variable
Update README.md with full project documentation: overview, features, architecture diagram (text), setup guide, API documentation, matching algorithm explanation, deployment guide
acceptance_criteria: Test files are properly structured and would execute with jest
Matching engine tests cover core scoring scenarios
Seed data creates realistic UK-based instructor and student profiles
Dockerfile follows multi-stage build best practices
CI workflow covers lint, typecheck, test, and build stages
verification: Verify CI workflow YAML is valid
findings: All files created successfully. Cannot run npm install/test/build due to INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network mode. Tests are structured to work with Jest once dependencies are installed. Dockerfile uses multi-stage build with standalone output mode added to next.config.js.
